summary: V4.6 backend testing — 67/67 pytest pass (27 regression + 20 v4.5 + 20 new v4.6). Added /app/backend/tests/test_v46_features.py covering: GET /api/industries (5 industries; gas active + 4 coming_soon; 5 active gas subdomains), GET /api/system-templates (4 seeded templates with placeholders, is_system=true, no data_b64 leaked, industry filter returns 4), POST /api/system-templates/{key}/clone (creates user template with source_system_key + appears in /api/templates), Multi-project CRUD (list returns >=1 with single active flag, POST /api/projects creates+activates, /activate switches active, /archive hides from default list, include_archived=true exposes, /unarchive flips back, DELETE returns deleted=true and is 404 on retry, PUT /api/project updates the LAST-activated project), Developer auto-detection (register/login with dragosserban95@gmail.com → is_developer=true & plan='developer'; regular user is_developer=false), AI Developer endpoints (POST /api/dev/plan as dev returns mode='plan'+proposed_steps+diagnostic{rules,missing_capabilities}+validation_checklist; 403 for non-dev), GET /api/dev/safety-rules returns 9 rules for dev, 403 otherwise, PUT /api/qes/credentials with certsign returns ok+fields_saved=3, unknown provider → 400, GET /api/qes/credentials returns only {certsign:{fields_count:3}} without raw secret values.

minor.issue: DEVELOPER_EMAILS constant and _is_developer_email() are duplicated (defined at line 57 AND again at line 614). Harmless but should be deduped.
When openai_api_key is omitted, route still runs fine but the diagnostic field 'next_safe_actions' is built unconditionally — fine, just note for spec.

Deleting the currently-active project re-activates the oldest non-archived project (good), but if NO non-archived projects remain the user has active_project_id=null, and a subsequent GET /api/project will auto-create 'Proiect implicit' — acceptable but undocumented.

action_items: (Cleanup) Remove duplicate DEVELOPER_EMAILS / _is_developer_email definition in server.py (lines 614-618 already declared at 57-61).
(Optional) Document the auto-recreate behavior of /api/project after deleting all projects — currently spawns 'Proiect implicit' silently.
(Optional) /api/auth/google/session still hard-codes is_developer=False; should call _is_developer_email(email) to match the email/password path (single sign-in source equivalence).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: DEVELOPER_EMAILS and _is_developer_email() are declared twice (lines 57 and 614). Second declaration is dead. Remove.

/api/auth/google/session does NOT auto-detect developer accounts — only email/password register & login do. A Google sign-in by dragosserban95@gmail.com would yield is_developer=false until they also do an email-password login. Apply _is_developer_email() symmetrically.

/api/qes/credentials PUT does NOT validate credential field names against a per-provider schema — any dict is accepted. Provider 'certsign' should require {client_id, client_secret, endpoint_url}; consider rejecting unknown keys or missing required keys.
/api/qes/credentials GET returns fields_count but credentials are stored in plaintext under users.qes_credentials. For production these MUST be encrypted at rest (Fernet/KMS).
/api/dev/plan logs prompt[:300] but accepts arbitrarily long prompts (no Pydantic max_length on DevPlanRequest.prompt). Add Field(max_length=4000).

/api/projects POST: ProjectCreate accepts ANY industry/subdomain string — no validation against industries_module.INDUSTRIES. A typo creates orphan projects. Should validate with industries_module.get_industry()/is_active().
industries.py.get_industry() falls back to 'gas_engineering' on unknown id — silent default may mask bugs; should return None and let callers decide.
system_templates.seed_system_templates re-encodes & overwrites all template documents on every startup (full data_b64 rewrite) — wasteful. Use change-detection (hash compare) before update.

models.py User exposes qes_credentials in /auth/me response (it's whitelisted via _user_from_doc which only strips password_hash & gmail_app_password). Verify in next iteration that qes_credentials is also stripped — otherwise raw client_secret leaks to authenticated client.

_get_active_project is a 30-line function repeated indirectly across 6 routes — fine, but the project auto-creation on first GET /api/project has no lock; two parallel requests could create two 'Proiect implicit' rows (low risk single-tenant).

ai_developer._call_openai uses gpt-4o-mini which is fine, but no key redaction in error message — a bad key string could leak via 'external_llm_error' in response. Trap and replace with generic message.
